items.summary: No independent human desktop task-completion receipt is present.
items.closure_test: Repeat the canonical Studio task flow on desktop and record completion, confusion points, browser/OS and recovery from invalid import.

items.summary: Static accessibility hooks exist, but screen-reader and full keyboard usability are not physically observed.
items.closure_test: Run keyboard-only and screen-reader task flow; verify focus order, announcements, labels, evidence filters and error recovery.

items.summary: Source is standards-based, but compatibility is not inferred without browser execution.
items.closure_test: Run canonical smoke on current Chromium desktop, Chrome Android and Firefox; record failures separately and do not pool incompatible results.

items.summary: Installable/offline PWA is deliberately deferred until the main task flow has human evidence.
